title: Human Space Exploration
description: Key milestones in human exploration of space, from early orbital satellites to interplanetary rovers.

events.title: Sputnik 1 Launch
events.body: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, the first artificial Earth satellite. Its radio signals triggered the dawn of the Space Age.

events.title: First Human in Space
events.body: Yuri Gagarin became the first human to travel into space, completing one orbit of Earth aboard Vostok 1 in 108 minutes.

events.title: Apollo 11 Lands on the Moon
events.body: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Apollo Lunar Module Eagle on the Moon, stepping onto the surface while Michael Collins orbited above.

media.caption: Buzz Aldrin on the surface of the Moon during Apollo 11

events.title: Skylab Launched
events.body: America's first space station was launched into low Earth orbit. It supported three crewed missions that conducted hundreds of medical and scientific experiments.

media.caption: Skylab space station photographed from departing crew capsule

events.title: Voyager 1 Launch
events.body: Voyager 1 was launched on an interstellar trajectory to explore the outer solar system, becoming the farthest human-made object from Earth.

media.caption: Artist model of the Voyager spacecraft

events.title: Hubble Space Telescope Deployed
events.body: The Space Shuttle Discovery deployed the Hubble Space Telescope, providing unprecedented high-resolution astronomical views of deep space.

media.caption: Hubble in low Earth orbit after servicing mission

events.title: First ISS Module in Orbit
events.body: The Russian Zarya module was launched into orbit, beginning continuous assembly and over two decades of permanent human habitation in space.

media.caption: The International Space Station in orbit

events.title: Curiosity Rover Lands on Mars
events.body: NASA's Curiosity rover touched down in Gale Crater on Mars using a revolutionary sky crane landing maneuver to search for past habitable environments.

media.caption: Self-portrait of Curiosity rover on the Martian surface
